import pytest
from src.validation import validate_username

def test_validate_username():
    # valid cases
    assert validate_username("abc") is True
    assert validate_username("a1_") is True
    assert validate_username("abc123_") is True
    assert validate_username("___") is True
    assert validate_username("a_b_c") is True
    # invalid cases
    assert validate_username("") is False
    assert validate_username("ab") is False  # too short
    assert validate_username("Abc") is False  # uppercase
    assert validate_username("a b") is False  # space
    assert validate_username("a-b") is False  # hyphen
    assert validate_username("a@b") is False  # special char
    assert validate_username("a.b") is False  # dot
    assert validate_username("a+b") is False  # plus
    assert validate_username("123") is True  # digits only allowed
    assert validate_username("_12") is True  # underscore and digits
    # length exactly 3
    assert validate_username("xyz") is True
    assert validate_username("x_y") is True
    # longer strings with invalid char
    assert validate_username("a"*9 + "!") is False

import pytest
from src import validation

def test_validate_username_enforces_lowercase():
    # According to claim, uppercase should be rejected
    assert not validation.validate_username("Abc")  # expecting False
    # Also ensure valid usernames pass
    assert validation.validate_username("abc")
    assert validation.validate_username("a1_")
    assert validation.validate_username("abc123_")
    # length less than 3 should fail
    assert not validation.validate_username("ab")
    # non-allowed characters
    assert not validation.validate_username("abc!")
    assert not validation.validate_username("abc def")
